content.title: ELAN Q3 Deep Dive: Innovation Drives Growth, but Market Eyes Margin and Competition
content.summary: Animal health company Elanco (NYSE:ELAN) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 10.4% year on year to $1.14 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $1.10 billion at the midpoint, 1.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.19 per share was 43.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
